violations.description: Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not stored in a clean, dry location a minimum of 6 inches above the floor. -Dry storage rack is being leaked on by condensation caused by the AC unit. Advise protecting product from water damage or moving out from under duct work.

Refrigerated Storage. — --Refrigerator or cold storage was insufficient or ineffective at maintaining potentially hazardous food at a temperature of 41F or less. -Sliding glass cooler in back room is not holding product below 41F. It is currently holding around 60F. Staff is aware and has a tech on the way. Food product was moved to a working cooler.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. -Base of the the wall by washing machine is pealing away. -Some tiles in kitchen area are cracked.
General premises. — --Opening to outside or portion of building, was not protected against the entry of insects and rodents. -Door by the wash machine has light coming through the seal.
